_note: Run caption_compose.py from the wod-timer repo root: raw_dir, fonts and icon are repo-relative.

01.headline:
Readable from
across the gym
01.proof:
Giant numbers. Voice-coached rounds.
Beeps over the music.
01.feature_proof: Voice-coached EMOM, AMRAP, Tabata and For Time. Phone, tablet, watch.

02.headline:
EMOM · AMRAP
Tabata · For Time
02.proof: Set up in two taps. Round changes called out.

03.headline: On your wrist too
03.proof:
Apple Watch and Wear OS.
Hand an EMOM to Apple's Workout app.

04.headline:
Count up
or count down
04.proof: For Time with a cap. Flip the toggle, hit START.

05.headline:
Three voices
or just beeps
05.proof:
Major, Liam or Holly.
Cues play through the silent switch.

06.headline:
Green means work.
Pink means rest.
06.proof: Colour-coded phases. A haptic hit on every change.

07.headline:
One glance.
Time and round.
07.proof:
Tap the screen to count a round.
The bar shows what's left.

08.headline:
Finish. Read it.
Go again.
08.proof:
Your time in giant digits.
AGAIN reruns the same workout.

09.headline:
Stays awake.
Stays exact.
09.proof:
Screen stays on. Lock it or switch apps,
the clock holds.

10.headline:
No account.
No ads. No clutter.
10.proof:
Pick a format, set the time, hit START.
Then just work.
